prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test resulted in a statistically significant win.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-2.2% overall).
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-2.3% overall).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and path redesigns (choose_path, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
Evidence is still thin for home flows (home, new_flow) and adoption flows (adoption, new_flow), as each has only 1 test.
Predictions were generally overly optimistic and ran too high across most tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -1.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +1.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -2.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +2.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Account Backup Safety Note: Displays explicit reassurance text on the sign-in screen informing users that logging in saves their desktop pet safely to their account. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Path Selection Full Bleed Redesign: Redesigns the path selection screen with a full-bleed layout and prominent path option cards to speed up selection. (why: The choose_path stage has a high mean duration of 514s and a 23.8% dropoff rate.)
2: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Lighting Guidance Hint: Adds a clear hint on the photo upload screen advising users on lighting and pose for optimal pet generation. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, contributing to the 60.9% adoption conversion rate.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Mascot Audio Feedback Flow: Adds visual mascot animations, sound effects, and time estimates to the waiting screen during pet generation. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s and median of 201s, causing user dropoff before reaching home.)
4: [finish, layout] Home Intro Compact Controls Overview: Switches home_intro to a compact layout detailing how to control, minimize, and talk to the desktop pet. (why: 3 support tickets reported confusion post-onboarding regarding how to control or hide the pet.)
5: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pick Friend Preview Stage Flow: Upgrades the friend selection screen into a stage layout featuring live animated pet previews and sound clips. (why: Adoption has a low 60.9% conversion rate with long decision times (89s median / 1017s mean).)
6: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Connection Trouble Hint: Adds a diagnostic hint to the sign-in screen to assist users if the sign-in prompt stalls or fails to render. (why: Support received reports of the sign-in screen failing to appear or stalling prior to completion.)
7: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Intro Preview Screen: Inserts a short dedicated introduction screen before path selection to set clear expectations about desktop pets. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path with a 514s mean time due to initial lack of context.)
8: [finish, notification] Home Desktop Readiness Notification: Enables a ready notification trigger and hint guiding users to check their system taskbar once setup completes. (why: Support received 3 emails stating the pet does not show on the desktop or the app appears unresponsive.)

scores.note: Strong support mail evidence for sign-in anxiety; low cost text reassurance.
Redesigns on choose_path showed negligible historical lift (+0.1%).
Targeted step has highest dropoff (39.1%); cheap copy hint with support validation.
Addresses long wait times on home stage, but requires heavy media flow work.
Finish step has 35.2% dropoff and user confusion; layout tweaking is medium cost.
High dropoff stage, but adoption new_flow previously registered negative lift (-1.1%).
Cheap diagnostic hint directly addressing technical stall reports during sign-in.
Adding new extra screens previously caused dropoff (-2.3% on finish new_screen).
Addresses post-setup invisibility issue at finish stage with modest effort.
